description: Edit a list's title, subtitle, or category. Saves the working version without publishing. Readers keep seeing the last approved version until the owner approves a list update.

category.description: The category the person chose: Food & Drink, Travel, Books, Music, Movies & TV, Gear & Tools, Software, Fashion, Home & Garden, Ideas & Essays, Art, or Spirituality. Their choice stays; an empty string clears it.

list.description: Which list: slug, exact title, or id. Must match exactly one list or the call fails.

subtitle.description: New subtitle. Pass an empty string to clear.

name: update_list
title: Edit a list
